title: Shieling Square, Howth Road, Raheny, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: Shieling Square, Howth Road, Raheny, Co. Dublin
description:
Shieling Square consists of contemporary 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments and penthouses. The development is located on the Howth Road, Dublin 5 - an area widely regarded as one of the most prestigious locations in north Dublin. It is easy to understand why this leafy suburb is so sought after and why it has developed into a top class residential area, with its tree-lined avenues and a variety of large homes. Located on an elevated piece of ground above the seafront, Shieling Square enjoys stunning views across Dublin Bay and provides easy access to local amenities and leisure activities such as the coastal walkway, Bull Island, Clontarf, Howth and Malahide.

These apartment is beautifully presented and fully furnished with a high spec finish throughout, taking advantage of the stunning surrounding view. The apartment consists of a spacious open plan kitchen/living/dining room, with ample storage and facilities for all your entertaining needs. There are 3 large double bedrooms (two en suite) with plenty of built in wardrobe space.
